narrative.text: I’ll read the frozen contract and repository instructions first, then implement the opt-in view, add the required probes, and run the predeclared base/head gates.The frozen §4 requires both the read-only view and a bounded host projector. I’ll store the sidecar on real `ChannelRegistry` entries and give the binder an epoch-scoped view. The existing lane checks can enforce post-await invalidation without edits to their RequiredAdmission blocks. A small additive change to `inbound-admission.ts` is needed to pass the view to the binder and tie it to epoch lifetime.The focused suite is green: 72 tests pass, including 50 synthetic fixture ingress cases and real framework tests for push ordering, post-A/B replacement races, epoch invalidation, immutable snapshots, ancestry, and B send-time refusal. Next I’ll run the four required mutants, then commit and run the predeclared sequential Node gate matrix.All four required mutants were killed by named tests. I also found two existing descriptor-rewrite paths that need scope invalidation: an inbound-only open response and lazy-placeholder backfill. I’ll add those checks before the head gates. The base run is continuing unchanged; the sequencer is paused before its first head run.
